data.body: Implemented (commit 59c12cdcb0fd on c0cf1022671), pushed as WIP Gerrit 3057; plan review PASS (signed) and claimed first. Root cause re-confirmed before the edit: with PYPANDOC_PANDOC=~/.local/pandoc-3.9/pandoc-3.9-arm64/bin/pandoc, test_the_installed_pandoc_matches_the_legacy_fixture_provenance FAILED: 'Pandoc binary SHA-256 mismatch for darwin-arm64: expected d7b1e75c..., installed 140353e1...'. Fix: ACCEPTED_PANDOC_BINARY_SHA256 per platform; installed and generating checks are membership; errors list the accepted set; SUPPORTED_PANDOC_BINARY_SHA256 (the generating map the fixtures embed) unchanged, so 0 files under tests/fixtures/ changed. After: the provenance test passes; the new test_darwin_arm64_accepts_both_byte_identical_binaries_and_rejects_a_third passes and fails on the pre-fix generator with the same mismatch; test_wiki_render_hardening.py + test_generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py 42 passed; docs/local-dev-env.md known-failure paragraph removed, check_docs_index --check exit 0; make lint and make typecheck exit 0 (the first typecheck caught an index on provenance.get(); fixed with a str() key after the existing membership check). make verify with PYPANDOC_PANDOC exported is running; %ready follows a clean result.
